meta.title: Kavento México — Custom digital solutions
meta.description: We are a Mexican development team. We build websites, apps, automations, WhatsApp chatbots and private AI for companies that need something made to fit.

hero.lead: We are a Mexican development team. We design and build websites, applications, automations, chatbots and private artificial intelligence for companies that need something made to fit.
hero.sunAlt: Kavento solar mark animated in three dimensions

about.title: What we do
about.p1: We build custom software. You arrive with a problem — a process that eats hours, a system that no longer holds, an idea that does not exist yet — and you leave with something running in production.
about.p2: We work with Mexican companies of every size. We do not resell templates or third-party licenses: we write the code, deploy it and maintain it with you.
about.p3: If it is digital, we build it.

services.title: What we build
services.lead: Five lines of work. A project almost always touches more than one.

web.title: Web development
web.body: We build sites and platforms that load fast, look right on any screen and that you can update without depending on us.

automation.title: Process automation
automation.body: We connect the tools you already use so they stop asking you for manual work. What takes hours today, we leave running on its own.

software.title: Custom apps and software
software.body: We design and develop web and mobile applications built for how you actually operate, not for the market average.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp chatbots
whatsapp.body: We answer your customers on the channel where they already write to you: quotes, appointments, follow-ups and support, replied to on the spot.

ai.title: Private AI and language models
ai.body: We deploy language models on your own data and your own infrastructure. Your information never leaves your company.

team.title: Our team
team.lead: We are a small, direct team. You talk to the people who write the code.
